issues.desc: 과학기술부 had no minister and no vice minister from 1998-02-28 (new 정부조직법 in force) to 1998-03-02. 연합 1998-02-28 reports the seven new ministries, 과학기술부 among them, headless. No acting head was identified. 강창희 was appointed on 1998-03-03.

미래창조과학부 had no minister from its creation on 2013-03-23 to 2013-04-16 after nominee 김종훈 withdrew on 2013-03-04. The vice ministers were appointed on 2013-03-24, so 2013-03-23 had no official head at all. 제1차관 이상목 was the highest official (listed under acting). No formal 직무대행 order was found.

오명 start: the gazette section date is 2003-12-29 (관보 제15587호) while ko.wikipedia and the old panel use 2003-12-28, the announcement day. The gazette date is used. 박호군's end is set to 2003-12-29 accordingly.

The builder's 1997-03-05 is the announcement day. No gazette file exists for 1997. Outside the window, tenure length only.

The deputy PM title changes (2004-10-18 오명, 2025-10-01 배경훈) do not rename the ministry. Each person has two spells split on that date because a new appointment notice was issued and deputy_pm changes. Both second spells carry reorg_continuation=true and reappointed_on_reorg=true, and the first spells carry end_reason ministry_reorganized. Merge them downstream if one spell per ministry name is wanted.

For replaced ministers the end is the successor's appointment date (end_confidence inferred_from_successor, same-day handover). 이임식 dates that differ are noted: 최문기 2014-07-15, 임혜숙 2022-05-09. The gazette does not print exits.
